name: shipfast/live-edit
description: Config-driven, in-place live-edit CMS for Laravel sites: tag HTML elements, edit content, images, links, icons, styles, collections and nav in place.

suggest.league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3: Required to store snapshots and images on S3 (set LIVE_EDIT_SNAPSHOT_DISK=s3).
suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: Required only to sign CloudFront URLs for a private distribution.
suggest.illuminate/database: Provided by any Laravel application; needed only for the Eloquent-backed side of the engine.
suggest.illuminate/http: Provided by any Laravel application; needed only for the HTTP API and the remote content driver.
